problem.title: How do I prompt for a file without uploading it in HTML
problem.description: I have some legacy html code, (actually created by a python script), that I am maintaining that prompts the user to enter various fields in a table. Then, upon Submit, those fields are written to a Mongodb database. One of the fields is a file name. The Problem: The file name entry field uses an input type="file" When the data (file name) is pulled from the form, the file starts uploading. I don't need the file, just the file name.
